methodology.processes: one independent process per source/scenario, executed sequentially
methodology.rss: Linux process peak RSS includes imports, fixture setup and all operations in that scenario; it is not isolated allocation per operation
methodology.selections: half of atoms for native extraction; two nonconsecutive structures for structural extraction; two atoms and two structures for private H5 codec read
claims: Topology output now intentionally excludes chemical payloads; reduced copy/extract work follows the accepted new domain contract.
Full MolSys retains every state and is not claimed faster. Repeated full-copy medians vary, with overlapping ranges; profiles show no duplicate chemistry clone.
Chemical-only edits preserve the existing coordinate storage identity in both sources.
The H5 block measurement invokes a private codec; it is not a new public file-backed query API.
